reviews.comment: If you are good at math I would recommend him, I did very well in his class because I understood the material before and would do the homeworks repeatedly until I understood them. He is pretty relaxed, but this is a math class so it is going to be difficult. Just make sure to practice and be confident in the problems before the tests.
reviews.ratingTags: Lots of homework--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: He seemed like he liked teaching however, he would often get problems wrong in class. He would do problems wrong and confuse the class then reteach it the next class. Nice guy just inexperienced in teaching.
